shortDescription: True fans show their subscription receipts and skip the line — Wildcard fast-track signup for KIMI Talk events
longDescription: Browse upcoming KIMI Talk and official community offline events and sign up in a conversation. Power users can authorize a read-only capture of their own KIMI subscription page (plan, usage, member since, subscription count) for Wildcard fast-track verification. Wildcard is a generic event-signup tiering tool; this plugin is the KIMI community edition.
tryPrompts: Show me upcoming KIMI Talk events
I want to sign up for the Shanghai KIMI Talk
I have a Wildcard — use fast-track verification for my signup

kimi-talk-signup.description: Browse and sign up for KIMI Talk events; power users get Wildcard fast-track verification via their own subscription info
